newsitem.title: USA: Chicago Purchasing Mgrs Nov index rose to 57.6.
newsitem.headline: Chicago Purchasing Mgrs Nov index rose to 57.6.

text.p: The Chicagoland Business Barometer rose to a seasonally adjusted 57.6 in November from 56.9 in October, the Purchasing Management Association of Chicago (PMAC) said on Wednesday.
An index below 50 signals a slowing manufacturing economy, while a reading above 50 suggests expansion.
The prices paid index was unchanged at 50.7 in November.
The employment component of the barometer fell to 47.6 in November from 48.8 in October.

(* indicates components used to calculate index)
The Purchasing Management Association of Chicago said the rise in the business barometer continues to "signal solid, if unspectacular, growth."
"Prices paid continue to signal moderation," the report said.
The association said the inventories component rose to its highest level since 1994. It added that production and new orders continued to expand while order backlog and employment retreated.
